column1: # CC-BY-4.0. Manually authored after reading all 40 actual complete texts and exact peer responses.
# Subject|one-based source ordinal|independent candidate disposition|own substantive rationale

Math|64|accepted_open_candidate|The response now treats experiment identification, documented outcomes and cardinality as one possible modeling product. It preserves all named work and leaves outcome-space breadth open. An illustrative finite experiment does not establish the full real-situation scope or a compulsory split.

Math|99|accepted_narrow_candidate_only|Product computation and its normal/area meanings share one geometric object. A nonzero product's direction and magnitude give both interpretations, while parallel/zero inputs must not be assigned a nonzero normal direction. This supports a narrow candidate, with the full three-dimensional and degeneracy rubric pending.

Math|103|accepted_narrow_candidate_only|The new candidate investigates the derivative as a rate, then extremizes that same rate. Endpoint comparison and the distinction between position and rate extrema are materially retained. A second derivative is a method of the single rate question; domain and local/global reach still need native/source decisions.

Math|106|accepted_open_candidate|The response preserves forward/inverse graph reasoning and the primitive role rather than deleting a direction to obtain narrowness. Additive-constant ambiguity and the source's two-versus-three role wording are real limits, so the open classification is appropriate.

Math|110|accepted_open_candidate|Forward parameter changes and inverse graph information can belong to one transformation problem. The response correctly avoids reconstructing a missing exponent or claiming all five parameters identifiable. The literal stored linear-looking expression requires source typography; the open role retains this blocker.

Math|131|accepted_open_candidate|Constructing a binomial decision rule and explaining its changed error behavior can be one test-design process. The response retains decisions and errors, with direction/threshold/alternative conditions unresolved. A single null-hypothesis error number cannot stand for every claimed error effect.

Math|135|accepted_narrow_candidate_only|This separate T-placement uses the same rate-extremum object, with domain and boundary checking retained. A polynomial rate example proves the mathematical coherence of the route, not its complete source/native coverage or an alias to the other profile's stable ID.

Math|138|accepted_open_candidate|The reversible qualitative graph idea is coherent, but the source's graph-role ambiguity and information loss remain. The response avoids accepting one forward slope reading as full evidence and retains its independent T-context binding.

Math|142|accepted_open_candidate|The T-context's graph/parameter investigation can be integrated. The response keeps exponent recovery and parameter nonidentifiability open rather than inserting an assumed exponential formula. Literal profile agreement does not resolve this content defect.

Math|158|accepted_narrow_candidate_only|Deducing a special spatial location and expressing that location verbally and in an oblique sketch are coordinated evidence for one decision. The response retains all three performances and both line/plane objects. Exact special-location/equation coverage is pending, so this is a candidate rather than an approved atom.

Math|192|accepted_open_candidate|Self and peer evidence can support one reflective improvement process. The response retains the specified competence dimensions and transfer, while the unknown project subject and evaluation rubric prevent a Math-owner or narrowness decision.

Math|215|accepted_open_candidate_with_additional_scope_limit|Primitive construction and verification need not split, and the exponent/domain limits are correctly open. The verification sentence does not repeat the affine-power restriction: a supplied F may differentiate to another rational f. The coherent candidate sentence therefore cannot yet be accepted as the entire source scope; preserve this additional verification reach pending primary-source clarification.

Math|234|accepted_narrow_candidate_only|In this separate M13 placement, normal direction and the two areas follow from one cross product. The parallel case is explicitly retained, so the mathematical meaning is coherent. No shared alias, owner choice or profile-equivalent assessment follows from equal wording.

Math|240|accepted_narrow_candidate_only|The special-position decision has verbal and drawn expressions of the same geometric result. The response preserves source M13 wording, line/plane scope and all displays; actual location families and equation forms remain native/source-bound pending.

Math|249|accepted_open_candidate|The original OR between integration methods is genuinely respected. A chosen method can solve one primitive/integral/area problem, and the response still requires correct interval/sign treatment. It does not use this counterroute to waive curriculum-wide method coverage or create an AND prerequisite union.

Math|261|accepted_open_candidate|The separately bound M13 experiment-modeling product keeps random/nonrandom decisions, exhaustive outcomes and cardinality. Its unbounded everyday context remains open. A finite coin model does not settle all allowed outcomes or create an alias to M11.

Math|286|accepted_open_candidate|The separate T13 test-rule candidate integrates rule choice and changed decision errors while retaining all source actions. Threshold, hypotheses and error criteria remain necessary operational limits, not a reason for splitting each step.

Math|293|accepted_open_candidate|The response correctly withdraws narrowness: the source offers elementary theorem families rather than one specified theorem/proof procedure. A proof still requires selected known properties and a valid chain; an example theorem does not silently replace full transferable coverage.

Math|306|accepted_open_candidate|The response correctly recognizes the singular cardinality defect rather than blaming two verbs. The same zero matrix, even with all Cramer determinants zero, permits empty and infinite solution sets for different right sides. Nonsingular Cramer remains valid; normative consistency/rank reach and source repair stay pending.

Math|325|accepted_open_candidate|Tangent construction and axis-parallel conditions can be integrated. The source's arbitrary-point wording needs regularity limits: zero parameter velocity may still allow a geometric tangent, while a corner may not. The open response retains these cases without authoring a new general curve-analysis prerequisite.

Math|331|accepted_open_candidate|This separate Additum reflection remains assessable project process content with no fixed subject object. Self/peer review and several improvement dimensions can form one process. Neither Math ownership nor a profile inherited from Additum12 is established.

Physics|5|accepted_open_candidate|The representation now serves the comparison explicitly required by the source. The response retains instantaneous speed, displacement and appropriate units, with movement class and sampling resolution open. Integration is coherent without reducing evidence to plotting alone.

Physics|13|accepted_open_candidate|The response accurately corrects the old review's wording: the original says different times, not arbitrary times. Energy/work/friction can form one state account, but do not generally determine its time/path. Added dynamics or a supplied time law is only conditional support; the unresolved model/source blocker remains real.

Physics|16|accepted_open_candidate|Circuit functions and a mechanical analogy can be one physical explanation. The response retains actual element-to-function mapping and checks the analogy's limits. Unspecified circuit/component breadth stays open rather than being inferred as a compulsory separate model-theory goal.

Physics|20|accepted_open_candidate|A physics-based supply argument with explicit sustainability criteria and supplied context is constructive. The response retains substantive argumentation and keeps broader societal ownership unresolved; Physics here is a nonexclusive content reading, not an authoritative owner or a waiver of source criteria.

Physics|55|accepted_open_candidate|The source makes quantitative energy/efficiency work serve the assessment of efficient use. The response preserves units, physical quantities and an evidenced human/environment conclusion, while rejecting an unsupported full life-cycle inference. Nonexclusive Physics interpretation is appropriate candidate triage.

Physics|74|accepted_open_candidate|Design and quality appraisal belong to the same experimental product. The response retains independent development, actual systematic-error reasoning and rough greatest-error estimates, with the explicit no-intensive-error-calculation limit. Native breadth and experimental conditions remain pending.

Physics|81|accepted_open_candidate|The analogy is a representation of the same circuit function, with neither element naming nor a vague analogy accepted as sufficient. The separate Aspekte12 literal route is preserved. It supplies no automatic alias or assessment-depth equivalence with Ph10.

Physics|85|accepted_open_candidate|This separate sustainability argument can be physically grounded using explicit criteria/context. A general sustainability slogan is rejected. The nonexclusive Physics reading does not exclude later evidenced societal requirements or infer a second owner from the title.

Physics|94|accepted_open_candidate|Unequal heat capacities and phase transitions are meaningful cases of the same mixture-energy balance. The response keeps experiment, energy check, latent heat and final-phase consistency; a sensible-only mixture cannot satisfy it. Exact losses/material scope remains pending.

Physics|95|accepted_open_candidate|The same experimental gas-model construction connects controlled-variable data, plots, equation synthesis and interpretation. The source's under-guidance condition is retained. The response preserves explanation beyond formula recall and introduces no independent kinetic-theory derivation demand.

Physics|112|accepted_open_candidate|Three related kinematic coordinates and phasors can represent one harmonic motion. The response retains initial conditions, amplitudes/phases and all requested coordinates, so an x-only fit is insufficient. Source/native system and phase conventions remain open.

Physics|120|accepted_open_candidate|Reflection phase determines resonator boundary conditions and their eigenfrequencies in one coherent argument. The response retains fixed/free distinctions and quantitative dimension-frequency reasoning. The organ-pipe example does not replace or universally dictate the complete resonator scope.

Physics|127|accepted_open_candidate|Planning, safe execution and parameter inference can form one capacitor measurement process. Direct/indirect assumptions must be physically justified. The response correctly preserves the example status of the discharge curve and leaves the full named-quantity/safety coverage unresolved.

Physics|136|accepted_open_candidate|The separate Aspekte13 record preserves the representation's purpose as a movement comparison, including instantaneous speed. Sampling/movement boundaries remain open. Equal wording does not authorize an alias or the Ph10 profile's assessment scope.

Physics|144|accepted_open_candidate|The actual source says different times. The response preserves real friction and the demanded time-state connection rather than silently treating v(x) as r(t). The separate Aspekte13 title supplies neither the missing dynamics nor an assumed normative repair.

Physics|163|accepted_open_candidate|Amplitude and phase responses can jointly justify one resonance-transfer judgment. The response requires a physical bridge to a stated transfer criterion and keeps load/coupling/damping conditions open. A voltage peak alone is not accepted as universal optimum power transfer.

Physics|170|accepted_open_candidate|Own interference planning/execution and measured structure parameters may support one suitability judgment. The response retains this experimental autonomy and a concrete technical criterion, with geometry and application breadth still pending. A measured constant alone is insufficient.

Physics|186|accepted_open_candidate|A decay fit may support a technical-use judgment in the same investigation. The response retains physical parameter meanings, model validity and an explicit suitability criterion. It does not force one radioactive process merely from the parent heading or approve an offset-free fit without evidence.

Physics|190|accepted_open_candidate|The separate ABU Additum text keeps all three harmonic coordinates and both phasor/line displays with consistent initial conditions. It correctly avoids promoting describe to the T-goal's model autonomy or inferring participation rules from Additum. Full native boundaries remain pending.
